description: This file contains implementation of an iterator for manipulating and decompressing a compressed bitmap data structure (likely RLE-based), including functions for initializing, discarding elements, and discharging words into an output bitmap.

classes.name: rlw_iterator
classes.description: An iterator for traversing and manipulating the run-length encoded bitmap data.

methods.name: int next_word(struct rlw_iterator * it)
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next word in the buffer, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: void rlwit_init(struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * from_ewah)
methods.description: Initializes the iterator with a given bitmap, setting up internal pointers and reading the first word.

methods.name: void rlwit_discard_first_words(struct rlw_iterator * it,size_t x)
methods.description: Discards a specified number of words from the start of the iterator, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: size_t rlwit_discharge(struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * out,size_t max,int negate)
methods.description: Extracts words from the iterator into an output bitmap, optionally negating the bits, up to a maximum number of words.

ctags.name: rlwit_discharge
ctags.signature: (struct rlw_iterator * it,struct ewah_bitmap * out,size_t max,int negate)
